title: TTHE: Test-Time Harness Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2607.08124v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The behavior of an LLM agent is determined not only by the underlying model, but also by its harness: the executable program that constructs context, invokes tools, verifies intermediate results, and recovers from failures. Existing approaches typically optimize harnesses on training or development data and freeze the resulting programs at test time, limiting adaptation to shifts in task distributions, failure modes, and tool interactions. We ask whether the harness can instead be optimized during evaluation using unlabeled execution traces. We introduce Test-Time Harness Evolution (TTHE), which treats the executable harness as the state of test-time adaptation. On each unlabeled test batch, TTHE iteratively evolves a population of candidate harnesses through agentic proposers that reason over execution traces and explore diverse edit directions. translated_abstract: LLM智能体的行为不仅由底层模型决定，还由其脚手架决定：脚手架是构建上下文、调用工具、验证中间结果并从失败中恢复的可执行程序。现有方法通常在训练或开发数据上优化脚手架，并在测试时冻结所得到的程序，这限制了对任务分布、失败模式和工具交互变化的适应能力。我们提出这样一个问题：能否在评估过程中利用无标签的执行轨迹来优化脚手架？我们提出了测试时脚手架演化（TTHE），它将可执行脚手架视为测试时自适应的状态。在每个无标签的测试批次上，TTHE通过能够对执行轨迹进行推理并探索多样化编辑方向的智能体提议者，迭代地演化候选脚手架种群，并由裁判基于执行轨迹和源自执行的代理信号来选择候选脚手架。
tldr: TTHE提出在测试阶段利用无标签执行轨迹持续演化LLM智能体的脚手架程序，通过智能体提议者生成多样化候选并由裁判筛选，从而在无需标签的情况下实现对任务分布与失败模式变化的实时自适应。
en_tdlr: TTHE enables test-time adaptation of LLM agent harnesses by iteratively evolving candidate programs from unlabeled execution traces, where agentic proposers explore diverse edits and a judge selects candidates using execution-derived proxy signals.
